senses.gloss: f. (כָּפָה) inverting, כְּפִיַית המטה the lowering of the couch in mourning.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 15a:25">M. Kat. 15ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אבל חייב בכ׳ המ׳</he> a mourner is bound to have his couch lowered.

<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 2:9">Tosef. ib. II, 9</cite> <he>מי שקיים כ׳ המ׳ וכ׳</he> he who has been observing the lowering of the couch for three days &c., needs not invert it &c. Y. ib. III, 83ᵃ; a. fr.
